chunks: The Sacred House of Allah was so named because it was made forbidden for the polytheists to enter it.

key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, to whom the Sacred House is ascribed in honor
key_terms.الْحَرَامَ: the sacred or inviolable, denoting sanctity and prohibition
key_terms.الْمُشْرِكِينَ: the polytheists, those who associate partners with Allah
key_terms.بَيْتُ: the House, referring here to the Ka'bah or Sacred House
key_terms.يَدْخُلُوهُ: to enter it, meaning to enter the Sacred House or sanctuary

ai.seo_question: Why is the Sacred House called Bayt Allah al-Haram?
ai.summary: This report explains the designation of Bayt Allah al-Haram by linking it to the prohibition upon the polytheists from entering it. It highlights the sanctity of the Sacred House and the legal-sacred meaning embedded in the term al-Haram.
